title: [Decision] sys_* kernel objects, assessed as one set: which of the 58 platform identity actions may an agent ever reach (plain declaration / declaration + confirmation / human-only), executing #27681 B parameter 2 in one ruling
body:
director#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbQLcy8yg6vhJVXXi8

Ruled: 6523087116 · letter A+ (declarations written now; no automatic check) · 2026-10-30T12:41Z
Ruling-ref: 6523087116
Blocked-by: #27681

Filing gate ②: the maintainer, in the director summon right after ruling #27681 B (2026-10-30), verbatim: 「但是对于系统内核对象，是否应该统一评估一下。」 — one assessment of every system kernel object's actions instead of per-action rulings. This card is that assessment and the execution of #27681 ruling 6513869839's parameter 2. Filed by the director seat (summon #54 continuation 1, ledger objectstack#12708). ⛔ Not a claim. No `domain:*`: triage sets it (`domain:server` expected; the declarations live in `packages/platform-objects`).

## 维护者速读

- **范围：** 全仓声明了动作的 `sys_*` 内核对象只有 12 个，全在 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/`，共 58 个具名动作（审批、队列、作业、通知等 `sys_*` 对象今天不声明动作）。它们全是 `type: 'api'`，今天**没有一个**声明 `ai:` 块，即对 agent 全部不暴露；#27681 裁 B 后机制打开，但每个动作仍要作者声明才可达。
- **本卡问什么：** 一次裁清 58 个动作各属哪一档，之后作者按档声明，不再逐动作上决策箱。
- **三档：** **H 人工专属**（铸造凭据或会话、改变所有权与登录因子、销毁账号或组织；不得声明 `ai.exposed`，除非您点名）；**C 可暴露但必须人工确认**（破坏性生命周期动作：封禁、吊销、移除、禁用；`ai.requiresConfirmation` 不得为 false）；**E 可凭普通声明暴露**（加法类：邀请、添加、创建团队、启用、改自己的资料）。
- **席位初判：** H 19 个 · C 17 个 · E 22 个，逐条见下表。裁定后零个动作当天变化：暴露仍由作者在各动作上写 `ai: { exposed: true, description }` 时才发生。
- **请回：** `A / B / C`，席位推荐 **A**。

## Governing text

- #27681 ruling 6513869839 (letter B; parameter 2: credential- or session-minting actions never declared exposed without a ruling naming the action; `ai.requiresConfirmation` never `false` on them). This card replaces "one ruling per action" with one ruling per bucket, as the maintainer asked.
- ADR-0011: exposure opt-in, default off; `ai.description` required; confirmation parity (`ai.requiresConfirmation`, default on for destructive-looking actions); permission parity.
- ADR-0066 D4 as amended 2026-10-29 (6499781492): one gate, two surfaces; the design goal 「agent 和人类使用同一套系统」.
- ADR-0126: the packaged-action activation switch is the operator's layer and is unchanged by this card.

**Protocol statement.** `Metadata-protocol: none` — no key is added; the card assigns values an author may write to an existing key (`ai.exposed`, `ai.requiresConfirmation`) on platform-owned actions. `Clause-②: no`.

## Premises (read at `origin/main` `ded67bfb`)

1. The population: 12 objects, 58 named actions, all `type: 'api'`, 0 with an `ai:` block. Re-check: `git grep -l -E "^\s+actions:\s*\[" origin/main -- 'packages/**/*.object.ts'` → the 12 identity files; `git grep -c -E "^\s+ai:\s*\{" origin/main -- 'packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts'` → 0.
2. No non-identity `sys_*` object declares actions. Re-check: the same grep over `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/**/*.object.ts` and `packages/platform-objects/src/audit/*.object.ts` → 0 files.
3. Confirmation today is a `confirmText` on 20 of the 58 (the console dialog), not the ADR-0011 `ai.requiresConfirmation` key; the HITL path for MCP is the dev's first measurement under #27681 B.

## The rubric

| Bucket | Test | What an author may write |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **H** human-only | the action mints a credential or a session, changes who owns or who can log in, or destroys an account / organization | no `ai.exposed` without a maintainer ruling naming the action |
| **C** confirm | destructive or privilege-changing lifecycle act that is reversible or bounded (ban, revoke, remove, disable, leave) | `ai.exposed: true` allowed with `ai.description`; `ai.requiresConfirmation` must stay `true` |
| **E** eligible | additive or self-scoped act with no credential and no privilege escalation | `ai.exposed: true` allowed with `ai.description`; confirmation at the author's choice |

## The assessment (58 actions)

**H — human-only (19):** `sys_user.impersonate_user` · `sys_user.set_user_password` · `sys_user.create_user` (creates a login, optional password) · `sys_user.delete_my_account` · `sys_user.change_my_password` · `sys_user.change_my_email` · `sys_user.disable_two_factor` · `sys_user.generate_backup_codes` · `sys_two_factor.disable_two_factor` · `sys_two_factor.regenerate_backup_codes` · `sys_api_key.create_api_key` · `sys_api_key.restore_api_key` · `sys_oauth_application.create_oauth_application` · `sys_oauth_application.rotate_client_secret` · `sys_sso_provider.register_sso_provider` · `sys_sso_provider.register_saml_provider` · `sys_sso_provider.verify_domain` · `sys_member.transfer_ownership` · `sys_member.update_member_role` · `sys_organization.delete_organization`. (The last two role / ownership acts are privilege escalation, not lifecycle.)

**C — exposable with confirmation (17):** `sys_user.ban_user` · `sys_user.unban_user` · `sys_user.unlock_user` · `sys_user.set_user_manager` · `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` · `sys_session.revoke_session` · `sys_session.revoke_my_other_sessions` · `sys_invitation.cancel_invitation` · `sys_invitation.reject_invitation` · `sys_member.remove_member` · `sys_team_member.remove_team_member` · `sys_team.remove_team` · `sys_oauth_application.disable_oauth_application` · `sys_oauth_application.delete_oauth_application` · `sys_sso_provider.delete_sso_provider` · `sys_organization.leave_organization` · `sys_account.unlink_account`.

**E — eligible by plain declaration (22):** `sys_user.invite_user` · `sys_invitation.invite_user` · `sys_organization.invite_user` · `sys_member.invite_user` (text mirror) · `sys_invitation.resend_invitation` · `sys_invitation.accept_invitation` · `sys_member.add_member` · `sys_team_member.add_team_member` · `sys_team.add_team_member` · `sys_team.create_team` · `sys_team.update_team` · `sys_organization.create_organization` · `sys_organization.update_organization` · `sys_organization.rename_organization` · `sys_organization.set_active_organization` · `sys_oauth_application.enable_oauth_application` · `sys_user.enable_two_factor` · `sys_two_factor.enable_two_factor` · `sys_user.update_my_profile` · `sys_user.resend_verification_email` · `sys_sso_provider.request_domain_verification`.

(Count: 19 + 17 + 22 = 58. Two spread entries in `sys_user`'s array carry no own name and are not actions.)

## Options

| | What it does | What the team sees | Workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** adopt the table | The three buckets and the 58 assignments become the standing policy, recorded as a dated note under ADR-0011 (governed, Tier H) and pinned by one test in `packages/platform-objects` that refuses `ai.exposed` on an H action and `ai.requiresConfirmation: false` on a C action. Declarations for E / C actions land on pull, each with its `ai.description`. | One ruling, no per-action rounds; an AI author who declares exposure on an H action is refused at test time, loudly. Day one: no exposure changes. | server · 1 PR (ADR note + pin test) · S · the declarations later, per pull |
| **B** everything human-only now | All 58 stay unexposed; the table is recorded for a later re-assessment on pull. | Agents reach no `sys_*` action until a second ruling. | docs · XS |
| **C** E only | Only the 22 E actions become eligible; C and H both human-only. | Revocation / ban / remove stay click-only for agents. | server · 1 PR · S |

业务含义直译：A 是「钥匙柜分三格：机器人永远不碰的、要人点头才能碰的、可以自己拿的，一次贴好标签」；B 是「柜子先全锁，以后再说」；C 是「只开最轻的那一格」。

## 四维分析

- **① 项目长远合理性（领起）。** 两年后 agent 替管理员做日常运维（吊销被盗会话、移除离职成员、取消过期邀请）是主流形态（Agentforce、Entra Agent ID、ServiceNow Now Assist 都按能力逐项启用），而铸造凭据与改变所有权永远留给人。一张按风险分档的表，比逐动作上决策箱更稳：规则写一次，作者按表声明，评审只看档位对不对。B 把问题推迟到每一次拉动；C 把可逆的破坏性动作一刀切成人工专属，与「同一系统」目标只兑现一半。
- **② 实际业务拉动。** 板上无客户点名；拉动是您的设计目标与 #27649 已开放的 REST 身份动作。A 落地当天零暴露变化，所以不是投机扩张，是把边界写清。
- **③ 防 AI 犯错。** 风险集中在 H 档：被注入的指令若能让 agent 模拟登录或设密码，即账号接管。A 用 pin 测试在作者写下 `ai.exposed` 的那一刻响亮拒绝，而不是靠评审记得；C 档强制 HITL 确认，agent 的每个破坏性调用都要有人点头。
- **④ 创业阶段不扩散。** 不加键、不加部署开关；新增的是一条 ADR 注记和一个 pin 测试（测试，不是 CI 门禁的新零件；若您不要测试，划掉即可，表仍成立）。

os-decision-facets
① 长远：按风险分三档一次写清，作者按表声明，评审只看档位；比逐动作裁更稳
② 拉动：设计目标 + REST 已开放的身份动作；A 当天零暴露变化
③ 防错：H 档在声明处被 pin 响亮拒绝；C 档强制人工确认
④ 不扩散：不加键不加开关；一条 ADR 注记 + 一个 pin 测试
Prior rulings read: sys_, ai.exposed, impersonate, ban_user, MCP → #27681 B (6513869839), ADR-0011, ADR-0066 D4 amended (6499781492), ADR-0126; thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## Recommendation

**A.** 只看①选 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。Not B: it re-opens the per-action round the maintainer asked to avoid. Not C: it leaves half the design goal unmet for acts that are reversible and already confirmed in the console. Confidence gaps: the bucket of four self-scoped acts (`change_my_password`, `change_my_email`, `delete_my_account`, `update_my_profile`) was placed by their credential effect, not by a measured agent use case — the maintainer may move any row with one word; whether `ai.requiresConfirmation`'s HITL path reaches MCP end to end is #27681 B's first measurement, and this card's C bucket depends on it.

## After the ruling

- **A:** the server lane files nothing new — this card is the execution card: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`; one PR adds the dated ADR-0011 note (Tier H) and the pin test; E / C declarations arrive on pull as ordinary cards citing this ruling.
- **B:** record the table in the ADR note only; close this card `completed`.
- **C:** as A with the C bucket folded into H.

## Related

#27681 (ruling 6513869839) · #27506 · #27649 · ADR-0011 · ADR-0066 · ADR-0126 · `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/*.object.ts` · `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` · `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`

## Dedupe

Open `needs-user-decision` box read 2026-10-30T03:00Z: #27681 (the mechanism, ruled B), #27401 (connector tool pins), #27884, #27881 — none assesses the `sys_*` action set. #27506 / #27649 (the REST door) do not classify actions.
